deep_dive.title: Enabling Urgency-aware Robot Swarm Intralogistics using Smart IoT Tags
deep_dive.abstract: Warehouse items differ in how urgently they must be moved: perishable goods, pharmaceutical shipments, and just-in-time production materials must be delivered sooner than the rest of the stock. Decentralised robot swarms suit warehouses that cannot justify fixed automation infrastructure, but current swarm controllers treat all items alike or rely on an external scheduler to set priorities, so urgent items wait as long as ordinary ones. This paper presents a swarm logistics system in which each warehouse carrier holds an ultra-low-power Internet-of-Things (IoT) tag that broadcasts the urgency of its item over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Robots read these broadcasts directly and weigh urgency against travel distance when choosing which carrier to serve, so prioritisation happens at the item level without central scheduling. The system is evaluated in simulation and validated on real robots and IoT-tagged carriers against a proximity-only baseline. In the physical trials, priority alignment (i.e. proportion of urgent items served first), improved from 0.41 to 0.64, with a nonsignificant trend toward lower 95th-percentile (P95) delivery latency and throughput within 1.2% of the baseline. In simulation, the benefit grew with system size: across three larger configurations, P95 latency fell by 5.2% to 11.8% and priority alignment improved by 41.7% to 51.6%. Attaching urgency to the items themselves therefore allows a decentralised swarm to serve time-critical stock sooner while keeping the low infrastructure requirements that make swarm systems attractive for warehouse automation.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Urgency-aware robot swarm intralogistics for warehouses improves order picking efficiency by prioritizing urgent items using IoT tags.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对去中心化机器人群体内部物流中缺乏紧急感知导致紧急物品延误的问题，提出在每个仓库运载工具上搭载低功耗物联网标签，通过蓝牙广播物品紧急程度，机器人直接读取并权衡紧急性与行驶距离选择服务对象。实验表明，该方法能有效减少紧急物品等待时间，提升仓库整体拣选效率，为灵活自动化物流系统提供了低成本解决方案。

deep_dive.title: Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations
deep_dive.abstract: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires repeatedly planning collision-free paths for agents that continuously receive new goals upon reaching their current ones. While many learning-based planners have been proposed for LMAPF, most rely on oversimplified kinematic assumptions that may overlook motion constraints critical to real-world performance. In this work, we study a more realistic LMAPF model derived from many real-world automated warehouse systems, termed LMAPF-R2, which incorporates robust safety constraints and in-place rotation constraints. These constraints substantially increase coordination difficulty, particularly in highly constrained spaces. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL). We first augment neural policies with Causal PIBT, a single-step search-based planner that resolves agents' collisions and propagates their intentions. We then introduce a unified RL formulation that jointly optimizes agent and environment policies, where the environment policy learns graph edge costs to provide global movement guidance via backward Dijkstra search. Experiments demonstrate that SJRL achieves significant improvements over the strong search-based planner, Causal-PIBT, across multiple high-density maps. We further validate SJRL in a challenging mixed-reality warehouse environment with 8 physical robots and 248 virtual robots.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding for automated warehouse systems to improve order picking efficiency with realistic motion constraints.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: The paper introduces a realistic LMAPF model with rotations for warehouses and a search-aided RL method to improve order picking efficiency by enabling robust, collision-free navigation in constrained spaces.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对自动化仓库中多智能体路径规划忽视旋转和真实运动约束的问题，提出了一种考虑旋转和鲁棒安全约束的终身多智能体路径规划模型LMAPF-R2，并设计了搜索辅助的联合智能体-环境强化学习方法。实验表明，该方法在高度受限空间中能有效提高路径规划的成功率和效率，为提升仓库订单拣选自动化水平提供了关键技术支持。
